name: Horror / Dark Mystery
core_identity: A horror film still built from suspense rather than shock: a quiet, dark place where something is clearly wrong. Most of the frame is shadow, and the viewer is left to imagine what is hidden. Pale faces, black voids and a cold green-blue cast make it recognizable.
medium: Horror film still shot digitally on cinema lenses with a cold, desaturated, low-key grade.
lighting: Very low key with a single weak source such as cold moonlight through a window, a bare bulb, a flashlight or a flickering practical lamp. Deep black shadows swallow half the frame, with hard-edged pools of light and long shadows. Thin fog or dust makes the light beam visible.
color_palette: Desaturated cold blue-green across the frame, deep true blacks, and small sickly yellow accents from old bulbs or candle flames. Skin looks pale and greyish. No bright colours and no red-heavy blood tones.
camera: Wide 20 mm to 35 mm lenses that exaggerate depth in corridors and rooms, with some tight close-ups on a face lit from the side or below. Deep focus on empty spaces, shallow focus when something lurks in the background. Static, low or slightly tilted angles.
composition: Large negative space with the figure small, off-centre or half hidden in darkness. Doorways, long corridors, stairs and windows frame the emptiness, and something stands just at the edge of the light. Symmetry is broken by one wrong detail.
texture: Damp peeling wallpaper, cracked plaster, dust, cobwebs, condensation on glass, rough wood and drifting fog. Grain is moderate and clumpy in the shadows.
characters: Real-looking people with pale, tense faces, wide or fixed eyes and shadows across the eyes and cheeks. Postures are rigid or frozen, with hands gripping a door or a flashlight. Clothing is plain, damp and crumpled; there is no gore, no blood, no wounds and no monster shown in full.
negative: gore, blood, wounds, explicit violence, severed limbs, cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, 3D render, CGI look, bright cheerful colors, oversaturated colors, daylight, comedy, text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, distorted hands, deformed face, duplicate people, blurry
motion_rules: Slow creeping dolly forward down a corridor or toward a door, or a slow lateral track. Figures stay unnaturally still, with only a slow breath, a head turning an inch or a curtain stirring. Fog drifts and a light flickers faintly. No jump scares, no fast cuts, no shaking and no sudden zoom.
